shots.visual: A drop of red blood falls onto the golden throne armrest while heavy iron chains rattle behind.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 誰敢在朕身後裝神弄鬼？

shots.visual: A scarred hand reaches out from behind the curtain and grips the hilt of the sword.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這柄刀，你動不得！

shots.visual: Liu Bei spins around with a cold sneer and tightly grabs the attacker's wrist.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 司馬昭？不，是曹丕殘黨！

shots.visual: Liu Bei violently twists the assassin's arm, throwing him onto the stone floor.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 敢在宮中伏擊，死路一條！

shots.visual: Zhuge Liang steps out holding a feather fan, looking down at the corpse in shock.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，此人搜出魏宮密圖！

shots.visual: Liu Bei stands on the left taking the bloody parchment handed by Zhuge Liang on the right.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 呈上來，朕倒要看看。

shots.visual: Liu Bei unrolls the ancient scroll revealing red glowing subterranean passages.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這是……皇宮地下密道？

shots.visual: Zhuge Liang points at the red markings with a solemn and stern look.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 密道終點指向海底寶庫！

shots.visual: Liu Bei paces near the altar, contemplating the dark subterranean route.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹丕當年竟藏了此等秘密。

shots.visual: Zhuge Liang inspects an strange copper token recovered from the dead assassin.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 只怕這寶庫隱藏毀滅陰謀。

shots.visual: Liu Bei puts on Sima Zhao's outer robe and mask, disguising his identity.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 朕便化身司馬昭入內探查！

shots.visual: Zhuge Liang bows nervously trying to persuade Liu Bei to stay back.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公不可親身犯險啊！

shots.visual: Liu Bei pushes open a heavy stone doorway under the throne altar.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 不入虎穴，焉得虎子！

shots.visual: Liu Bei walks alone holding a torch through a dark damp underground corridor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 劉備獨自步入皇宮地底密道。

shots.visual: Torchlight shines on a giant bronze mechanism carved into the underground wall.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這是曹丕留下的機關陣？

shots.visual: Liu Bei looks at a blueprint showing watergates connected directly to the Yangtze river.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 他竟想用龍脈淹毀大漢水師！

shots.visual: Above ground, Zhuge Liang rapidly calculates using stargazing tools, looking pale.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 不好，密道殺陣被啟動了！

shots.visual: Heavy iron gates drop in front of Liu Bei, blocking his retreat.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 區區鐵門，也妄想困住朕？

shots.visual: Liu Bei swings his blade with full strength, shattering the bronze lock on a chest.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 給朕開！

shots.visual: Inside the chest lies a sinister blood-soaked bamboo scroll.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這難道是曹丕的毒血詔？

shots.visual: Liu Bei reads the bloody scroll as ominous red light illuminates his furious expression.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 若朕稱帝，便開閘淹荊州？
